name: boogiebox
description: Music library metadata scanner and search

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run security:semgrep && cd client && npx vite build
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm run server-rs:test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm run server-rs:check
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:eslint && npm run server-rs:fmt:check && npm run server-rs:clippy
scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const v=fs.readFileSync('VERSION','utf8').trim(); const m=v.match(/^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)$/); if(!m) throw new Error('Invalid VERSION file'); const next=m[1]+'.'+m[2]+'.'+(Number(m[3])+1); fs.writeFileSync('VERSION',next+'\n'); console.log(next);" && node scripts/sync-version.mjs
